cc:Work.dc:title: Industrial emissions and carbon capture
cc:Work.dc:description: Global sectoral (a) greenhouse-gas emissions, (b) share of total industry greenhouse-gas emissions, (c) emissions per tonne of production, and (d) CO₂ capture. Industry shares use Emissions|GHG|Industry as denominator; the three sectors are not assumed to exhaust industry. Emissions intensity is a ratio of global sums. Capture is shown separately and is not subtracted again from reported emissions. GHG emissions and CO₂ capture use their distinct source units.
